narrative.overview: The existing Cinematic identity inherits the user's battle illustration. Local environmental motion preserves its composition and fixed foreground soldiers.
dos: Preserve the supplied source and silhouettes.
Keep environmental motion local and rendering bounded.
Retain host settings and the five-file offline pack.
donts: Do not move the whole painting or duplicate aircraft bodies.
Do not add a HUD, network dependencies or audio.
Do not infer device performance from a preview.
